_comment: Capability baseline for /capability-check (v14.6.0+). Snapshot of the Claude Code features and external deps this plugin currently USES or has deliberately considered. /capability-check diffs the LIVE Claude Code changelog/docs + dep versions against this file and reports candidate adoptions — it never self-applies. Maintainer updates this via `/capability-check --update-baseline` (a repo-root, committed action) after reviewing a report. The `product_directions` section is the home for /capability-check --strategy mode's scored, grounded, deduped product directions (each with status adopted | proposed | deferred); --strategy reads it to dedup (never re-proposing a recorded direction), and it is written only via `/capability-check --strategy --update-baseline`. NOTE: `baseline_date` + `plugin_version_at_last_scan` are the (date, plugin-version) pair of the last full platform/adoption scan — they record WHEN the `claude_code.*` lists were last refreshed, NOT the current plugin version. Both are bumped together only by a real `--update-baseline` adoption scan (Workflow A step 5). They are NOT bumped by `--strategy` direction edits: the `product_directions` section (introduced in v14.9.0) carries its own per-entry `date`s, so adding or restatusing a direction leaves the platform-scan pair untouched. The 2026-10-12 scan (twin-remediation/09 item 1) had PARTIAL coverage under the default 5-fetch budget: the hooks and sub-agents reference pages were read for the full current event/field lists, but the changelog only for v2.1.287-v2.1.296, so tools or plugin features shipped June-September and absent from those pages may still be unaccounted for.

NO-GO (2026-06-06 empirical probe): native worktree isolation aborted because the plugin's WorktreeCreate hook returned no worktree path. That blocking hook was REMOVED in v15.66.0 (measured 2026-09-11: the payload has no worktree_path and a WorktreeCreate hook replaces the harness git behaviour), so the probe's cause is gone — but adopting isolation: worktree is a SEPARATE decision (the plugin's worktree audit deliberately does not log the native population), not an automatic consequence. The 2026-10-12 scan adds doc evidence against a drop-in swap: the sub-agents reference says the native worktree branches from the default branch, not the parent session's HEAD, while Supervisor workers must branch from the run's feature branch. Re-probe in a reinstalled-plugin session before re-flagging (twin-remediation/09 item 2d). The 2026-09-11 hand-refresh of claude_code.hook_events_used was re-derived from hooks.json by the 2026-10-12 scan and is correct

product_directions.title: System Twin
product_directions.rationale: Evolve from a stateless task→PR runner into a System Twin — accumulated project-specific state is the only durable moat ('rent a coder vs. grow an engineer') that a competitor can't copy and the platform won't build (the three integrated pillars are in pillars[]; see provenance for detail).
